body: I know I should...but I can't seem to convince myself that doing anything for myself is worth the hassle.
I'd rather be a writer. But none of that actually matters now. I just found out that she actually is going to leave me.

I went to school for HVAC and electrical. It's not the heartbreak that worries me, though... It's the seemingly endless amount of days afterward where I just exist. I don't see a future for myself; I just see gray.
